name: saddle-pig-ride
comment: WP-2.6. ItemSaddle.saddleEntity / hitEntity. Stone platform y 60; the player (id 0) at (0.5, 61, 0.5) holds two saddles (hotbar 0, 1); pigs at (0.5, 61, 2.5) (id 1) and (-2.5, 61, -2.5) (id 2). t 2: interact with pig 1: EntityPig.interact is false (no saddle), so ItemStack.useItemOnEntity saddles it and the emptied stack leaves the hotbar (EntityPlayer.useCurrentItemOnEntity). t 5: interact again with an empty hand: a saddled pig takes the player on (mountEntity). t 40: interact again: the rider dismounts. t 45: hotbar 1; t 46: attacking pig 2 with the saddle (EntityPlayer.attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem: damage 1 + 1 while falling) saddles it through ItemSaddle.hitEntity, and the emptied stack leaves the hotbar. t 60: the player mounts pig 2.
